meta.name: Creator Dashboard — App Design System (Tailwind-first)
meta.goal: A comprehensive, app-specific style guide for AI (and humans) to build new features with consistent visuals. This document reflects the exact Tailwind tokens and component class recipes currently used in the app.

styleSummary: Modern editorial layout: large, confident type; generous negative space; strong left-aligned hierarchy.
Calm, trustworthy palette: deep heritage green as the anchor, pistachio as optimistic accent, bone/paper as the base.
Geometry with softness: rounded rectangles, layered panels, subtle linework patterns as quiet texture (not decoration).
Restraint over effects: minimal heavy shadows/glows; rely on composition and spacing.
doNotDo: Do not introduce new saturated UI colors outside the token palette (avoid neon, loud gradients).
Do not compress spacing or reduce line-heights to fit more content—this system breathes.
Do not outline everything with strong borders; use subtle separators and whitespace.
Do not overuse shadows; keep most surfaces flat and clean.
Do not introduce new font families without updating the global font import and Tailwind config.

styling.rule: Prefer token classes from Tailwind theme for color, typography, spacing, radius, and motion. Use arbitrary values only when a token does not exist and document it here.

fileOrganization.current: All UI is currently in creator-dashboard/src/App.jsx (including inline components).
fileOrganization.recommended: As the app grows, extract reusable components into creator-dashboard/src/components/ (e.g., Button.jsx, Card.jsx) while keeping styling aligned to this document.

responsiveness.rule: Use Tailwind responsive prefixes and the existing layout patterns (single column on mobile; 2 columns at md; 3 metric cards at md). Avoid bespoke breakpoints unless absolutely necessary.

styles.fontFamily: Sora (loaded via Google Fonts import) with system-ui fallback

usageRules: Primary emphasis panels: bg-brand-mughal-green with text-text-inverse.
Accent panels: bg-brand-pistachio with dark text (text-text-on-bone / text-text-primary).
Borders: border-border-subtle for dividers and card outlines.

fontFamily.note: Sora is the primary font and is imported via Google Fonts in creator-dashboard/src/index.css. Inter remains as a fallback.

radii.note: Project rule: all corner radii resolve to 4px (including chips/tags). The class names (rounded-xl, rounded-pill, etc.) may still appear in code, but they all map to 4px via Tailwind tokens.

library.rule: ALWAYS use lucide-react library for all icons. Do not use emojis, custom SVGs, or other icon libraries. lucide-react provides consistent, accessible, and well-designed icons that match the design system.
library.usage: Use icon components directly: <IconName className="w-4 h-4" />
library.sizing: Standard sizes: w-4 h-4 (16px), w-5 h-5 (20px), w-6 h-6 (24px). Match icon size to text size context.

doNotUse: Do not use custom SVG files
Do not use other icon libraries (Font Awesome, Material Icons, etc.)
Do not inline SVG code - always use lucide-react components

DecorativePatterns.description: Reusable SVG decoration patterns for hero sections and panels.

implementation.positioning: Use percentage-based coordinates for responsive scaling

examplePaths.name: bottomRightFlow
examplePaths.description: Flows from center-right towards bottom-right corner

implementationNotes: Always place decorative SVGs in a container with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none'
Use z-index to layer decorations behind content (decorations: z-5, content: z-10)
Parent container must have 'relative' and 'overflow-hidden' to contain decorations
Keep opacity low (0.2-0.6) to maintain text readability
Prefer pistachio (#8ACA74) or bone (rgba(220, 222, 197, ...)) colors for decorations

focus.rule: Every interactive element must have a visible focus style.

contrast.rule: Ensure text contrast is readable on green and pistachio surfaces. On green surfaces, default to text-text-inverse; on pistachio, default to text-text-on-bone or text-text-primary.

hitTargets.rule: Ensure buttons and clickable rows meet 44px minimum height on touch devices.

priorityOrderWhenBuilding: Start with the canvas: bg-surface-paper, centered 1200px container, generous padding (px-12, py-12).
Establish hierarchy: one hero/panel (green) + a small set of cards (white) + one accent panel (pistachio) when needed.
Use tokenized colors (brand/surface/text/border/state) and the existing type scale (text-sm/text-md/text-lg/etc.).
Keep corners consistent: 4px radius everywhere (no mixed radii, no fully-rounded pills).
Add subtle motion only (duration-normal; small hover tints or soft shadow).
compositionChecklist: Are sections separated by generous spacing (mb-12 / gap-6 / p-8)?
Is there one clear primary panel/idea per section (avoid 10 small boxes)?
Are borders subtle (border-border-subtle) and not used as heavy framing?
Are you reusing existing component recipes (Card, Chip, Button) rather than inventing new styles?
allowedCustomization: Add new component variants only if they reuse the same tokens and shape language.
Use new neutral tints derived from existing tokens only if strictly necessary for data viz; document them here.
avoidStyleDrift: Do not introduce new random hex colors in className.
Do not switch to a dense 'SaaS dashboard grid of tiny widgets' look; keep the editorial, spacious rhythm.
Do not add heavy drop shadows, glossy gradients, or high-contrast borders everywhere.
pricingPagePatterns: Use the billing toggle pattern (monthly/yearly) with a badge showing savings ('2 months free').
Apply 'Most popular' badge to the recommended plan using absolute positioning at -top-3 right-4.
Ensure badge uses whiteSpace: 'nowrap', display: 'inline-block', minWidth: 'max-content' to prevent text wrapping.
Highlight the recommended plan with bg-brand-mughal-green and inverse text colors.
Keep pricing cards in a 3-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with consistent gap-6 spacing.
decorativePatterns: Use curvy line SVGs in corners for organic accents (pistachio color, 20-25px stroke, 0.4-0.6 opacity).
Use large rounded rectangles partially off-canvas for geometric texture (bone color, 1px stroke, low opacity).
Always contain decorations in 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' with lower z-index than content.
Parent must have 'relative' and 'overflow-hidden' to properly contain decorative elements.
Use percentage-based coordinates for responsive scaling of SVG decorations.

blog.intent: Blog UI should feel like an extension of the app: editorial, spacious, token-driven, and calm. Use the same container width, paper canvas, subtle borders, and 4px corners.
entryPoints: A Blog section can appear at the bottom of dashboard-like pages as a teaser (latest 3 posts).
A dedicated Blog index page lists posts with search/filter/pagination.
A Blog post detail page renders the full article with a clear typographic hierarchy.
